semantics.csa_summary: CSA layers (compress_ratio==4) add a learned Indexer: window indices plus Indexer-derived compressed indices (offset=seqlen in prefill, offset=window_size in decode). The attention compressor writes compressed KV into kv_cache[:,window_size:] at index start_pos//4 on compression steps ((start_pos+1)%4==0).
semantics.hca_summary: HCA layers (compress_ratio==128) select compressed indices via get_compress_topk_idxs (no Indexer). The attention compressor writes compressed KV into kv_cache[:,window_size:] at index start_pos//128 on compression steps ((start_pos+1)%128==0).
semantics.kv_layout: kv_cache[:,:window_size] is the sliding ring; kv_cache[:,window_size:] is the compressed segment (size max_seq_len//compress_ratio when compress_ratio!=0).
semantics.sliding_summary: Sliding-only layers keep only the window ring buffer. Prefill writes the last window_size KV vectors (wrapping if seqlen>window_size); decode writes kv_cache[:bsz, start_pos%window_size]=kv.squeeze(1).
